name: Genotype, component and functional-perturbation tables
description: Represent actual strain/construct/component contrasts and their measured outcomes, preserving the distinction between a perturbation, its validated molecular effect and the endpoint being compared.

inputs.row_identity: strain, exact alleles/constructs, component mixture and condition
inputs.outcome: declared endpoint, units, source support and unknown status

outputs.matrix: separate genotype, molecular validation, localization/expression, endpoint and rescue fields
outputs.comparisons: requested matched contrasts and unresolved confounders

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Select rows satisfying a declared control rule

inputs.predicate: explicit conjunction over recorded fields, e.g. stable AND localized AND separation-defective

outputs.selection: matching original row IDs and measured values
outputs.unknowns: rows excluded because a field is unmeasured, not assumed negative

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

inputs.observations: pairwise, simultaneous, reconstituted and dependency records with assay conditions

outputs.relations: typed measured interactions/dependencies and explicit untested combinations

repository_catalog_defined: Source readers are repository-defined. No registered genetic-interaction, epistasis or complex-attribution agent is supplied by these operations.
research_operations_performed: causal EnvC Table 1 parse selected five stable/localized/function-defective variants among 20 rows.
cellular/yhcB_direct_observations.json extracted source-table and processed fitness/suppressor rows.
spatial/archaeal_processing/investigation.json contains declared small-panel rule audits, not a validated genome classifier.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: General typed contrast-matrix construction and interaction querying remain capability specifications for runtime.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: Deletion, complementation, suppressor selection, purified mixtures, fluorescence reporters, co-IP and interaction measurements are all author experiments here.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: A mutant called catalytic in another species is not a validated catalytic-null mutant in the target assay.
Overexpression rescue can establish capacity in that construct, not normal native contribution or direct chemistry.
Pairwise binding does not establish simultaneous occupancy; endpoint rescue does not by itself locate the causal route.
